articles.summary: We're all in on hybrid, and that means something different at HubSpot. Each employee can designate where they want to work - at home, at the office or a little of both - and have access to all of the same tools and resources. Hear from some members of our Product and Engineering group about how they stay connected and collaborate in a remote world.
articles.title: Product & Engineering Roundtable: How Remote Work Works at HubSpot
